name: star-atlas-app
description: Star Atlas analytics platform (web + api + bot)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,bot -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w @star-atlas/api" "npm run dev -w @star-atlas/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @star-atlas/shared && npm run build -w @star-atlas/api && npm run build -w @star-atlas/bot && npm run build -w web
